crossRefs.note: Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or…
He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know…
Elisha left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, “Let me please kiss my father and my mother, and then I will…
Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with…
They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.
Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”
But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”
He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t…
“If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and…
Therefore we know no one after the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now we know…

people.name: Zebedee
people.line: Father of the apostles James and John

translations.web: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.
translations.bsb: Immediately Jesus called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed Him.
translations.kjv: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.
translations.asv: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.
